sections.name: Diablos gang
sections.card:
Summary: A small Latin American gang that holds the Hepburn Heights district of Portland and is not well armed.
Weak points: They are poorly armed: in Grand Theft Auto III they use only baseball bats on the street, and guns appear only in missions.
Looks like: Members come in two kinds: a red bandana, light blue jeans and a dark blue jacket, or a blue bandana, a dark blue jacket and olive cargo pants.
Tips: Their gang car is the Diablo Stallion, in every game they appear in. The Uptown Yardies are their arch rivals.

sections.name: Triad gang
sections.card:
Summary: A Chinese criminal gang that controls the Chinatown and Callahan Point areas of Portland.
Weak points: The page gives no weak point; members carry baseball bats or pistols.
Looks like: Blue boiler suits and black bandannas.
Tips: They are enemies of the Leone Family and have a fierce rivalry with it.

sections.name: Leone Family (the Mafia)
sections.card:
Summary: The Italian mafia of Portland, based mostly in Saint Mark's with interests in the Red Light District, Chinatown and Trenton; the wiki calls it the most dangerous gang because of its shotguns.
Weak points: The page gives no weak point; what to respect is their powerful shotguns, which can easily blow up a normal car in two shots.
Looks like: Henchmen wear black suits, some with sunglasses, and their gang car, the Mafia Sentinel, is gray in Grand Theft Auto III.
Tips: Do not drive within range of their shotguns: they make quick work of vehicles. They have a fierce rivalry with the Triads.
